question: Monthly SMA10 state versus SPY passive and fixed 50 percent exposure: net scenario returns, risk and missed gains
research_identity: historical sequential current-vintage replay; NOT historical vintage reconstruction, unseen validation, live tracking or personal net account

universe.asset: single US large-cap equity ETF, USD
universe.selection: chosen today as broad US market proxy; no stock selection or CSI1000 inference

input.basis: Yahoo adjusted OHLC total-return approximation; do not add dividend cash again
input.calendar_status: same-vendor observed broad-market quote dates, must match exact full daily date set; not official independent exchange calendar

signal.formula: last completed calendar-month final observed adjusted close > arithmetic mean of inclusive last 10 consecutive month final closes
signal.decision: formation last quote close, hypothetical after-close availability; actual historical arrival unknown
signal.execution: first observed next-month open after prior-close decision, conditional observed calendar matched

position_targets.hold: 100% first opening only, then fixed adjusted units
position_targets.fixed50: 50% post-fee NAV at each month first open

account.fee_label: hypothetical all-in proportional friction, no minimums/tax/FX; NOT verified personal broker fees
account.terminal: mark to final close; no forced liquidation or terminal sale cost
account.daily_order: mark previous position at open incl overnight, rebalance subtract fee from traded notional, mark at close
account.target_solver: post-fee target w; buy notional=(w*N-S)/(1+w*f); sell notional=(S-w*N)/(1-w*f); no negative cash
account.baseline: same-cost SPY buy-and-hold total-return proxy, not official SP500 index
account.cash_opportunity_limitation: zero interest common to all; no risk-free or brokerage credit assumption

period_account_rule: slice one continuous daily account; use preceding last close as denominator; first period initial cash; do not reset holdings/charge new entry at boundaries
metrics: CAGR with exact fixed month count
close-to-close maximum drawdown including start anchor
trading-day longest underwater duration and recovered flag
sum fee dollars and fee/nav at trades
monthly returns and difference to hold
same-period cumulative return difference in percentage points
state-held open-to-next-open return decomposition: skipped positive vs negative months, not cash attribution
paired monthly mean difference and Newey-West 3-lag descriptive 95percent interval
policy: no LEI production rule replacement; independent research annotation/action scenario

sources.read_scope: reuse prior saved author discussion, no new source request; next-open and zero-cash-interest are local adaptations

checks: calendar dates same as broad-index source and every month consecutive
past states invariant to future rows and uniform positive scaling
fee proportional to actual notional; cash plus assets equals NAV; no overdraw
period decomposition reproduces continuous path; both baselines same dates/cost scenario
